about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Alessio, a full stack developer and DevSecOps consultant based in Belgium. With experience across the tech industry, I specialise in building secure, scalable web applications and infrastructure for clients across Europe and beyond.

My journey in tech started with a passion for coding and problem-solving, which led me to explore various programming languages and frameworks. Over the years, I've honed my skills in both front-end and back-end development, as well as cloud architecture and security best practices.

When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring the latest trends in technology, contributing to open source projects, or enjoying the great outdoors. I'm always eager to take on new challenges and collaborate with like-minded individuals to create impactful solutions.

about.whySubtitle: Here's what sets me apart from the rest.

whyCards.title: Security-First Approach
whyCards.text: Every line of code is written with security in mind. From secure architecture design to automated vulnerability scanning, I embed protection into the development lifecycle — not as an afterthought, but as a foundation.

whyCards.title: Fast & Reliable Delivery
whyCards.text: I combine agile workflows with CI/CD pipelines to deliver production-ready features quickly. You get clean, tested code on schedule — without sacrificing quality or cutting corners.

whyCards.title: Full Stack Expertise
whyCards.text: From responsive front-ends to robust back-end APIs and cloud infrastructure, I handle the entire stack. One point of contact, one cohesive vision — no gaps between design and deployment.

whyCards.title: Clear Communication
whyCards.text: No jargon, no disappearing acts. I keep you in the loop with transparent updates, honest timelines, and straightforward explanations — so you always know where your project stands.

items.a: I specialise in full stack development, DevSecOps consulting, and secure infrastructure design. Whether you need a web application built from scratch, an existing codebase hardened, or a CI/CD pipeline with integrated security — I can help.

items.q: What is your typical project process?
items.a: Every project starts with a discovery call to understand the scope, followed by a written quote. Once approved, I work in short sprints with regular check-ins so you always know where things stand. Delivery includes source code, documentation, and a handover session.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Absolutely. I'm based in Belgium but work remotely with clients across Europe and beyond. Communication is typically via email, video calls, or your preferred project management tool.

items.q: What tech stack do you typically use?
items.a: It depends on the project. For front-end work I lean towards Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS. On the back-end I work with Node.js, Python, and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure. Security tooling includes Snyk, SonarQube, and custom SAST/DAST pipelines.

items.q: Can you work with my existing codebase?
items.a: Yes. I regularly audit and extend existing projects. I'll start with a code review and security assessment, then propose a roadmap for improvements before writing a single line.
I offer retainer agreements for clients who need continuous support, dependency updates, and security monitoring after the initial project is delivered.

Most projects are quoted at a fixed price based on scope. For longer engagements or advisory work I also offer hourly or monthly retainer rates. You'll always receive a transparent breakdown before any work begins.
Invoices are due within 30 days. For larger projects I typically work with a 40 % upfront deposit and the remainder upon delivery. Full details are in my Terms & Conditions.

items.q: Who owns the code after delivery?
items.a: You receive a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the delivered software after full payment. Intellectual property details are outlined in my Terms & Conditions.

sections.heading: 1. General
sections.body: Alessio Miccichè, located in Zutendaal, Belgium, is responsible for the processing of personal data as described in this privacy statement. As a Security-Focused Engineer, I prioritize the confidentiality and protection of your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 2. Data Collection & Processing
sections.body: I process personal data because you use my services or contact me directly. This includes:
list: Contact Form: Name, email address, and the content of your message. This data is securely routed via Formspree.
Business Relations: If we collaborate, I process company names, addresses, VAT numbers, and billing details for project execution and legal compliance.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Your data is used strictly for:
list: Communication and responding to inquiries or quotes.
Executing technical engineering tasks (e.g., DevSecOps implementations, infrastructure-as-code).
Complying with legal and tax obligations (e.g., Belgian tax declarations).

sections.heading: 4. Engineering Standards & Security
sections.body: Security is at the core of my workflow. I implement the following measures to protect your information:
list: Encryption: All traffic to this website is encrypted via SSL (TLS).
Secret Management: Sensitive data, such as API keys and credentials, are never stored in source code (Git). I manage these exclusively through secure environment variables.
Direct Access: You have direct contact with me. There are no third-party intermediaries with access to your project data or personal information.

sections.heading: 5. Data Retention
sections.body: I do not store your data longer than strictly necessary. Administrative data and invoices are kept for the legal period of 7 years. Project documentation and code are retained for the duration of our collaboration or until a request for deletion is made.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact me via the contact page.

sections.heading: 1. Website Use
sections.body: By accessing this portfolio, you agree to use it for lawful purposes. Unauthorized scraping, malware distribution, or attempting to breach the security of this site is strictly prohibited.

sections.heading: 2. Service Provision (B2B)
sections.body: The following terms apply to all professional engineering services, consultancy, and software delivery provided by Alessio Miccichè:
list: Best Efforts: Services are performed to the best of my professional ability (inspanningsverbintenis). No specific result is guaranteed unless explicitly stated in writing.
Browser Support: Support is guaranteed for the last two major versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge. Legacy browsers are not supported.
Data Provision: The client is responsible for timely delivery of necessary assets (API keys, credentials, designs). Delays caused by the client are at the client's risk.

sections.heading: 3. Payments & Late Fees
sections.body: Invoices must be paid within 30 days. Failure to pay on time results in an automatic default. In such cases, a late interest rate of 10% per year and a fixed compensation fee of 10% (min. €75) will be charged.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property & Licensing
sections.body: All source code, designs, and documentation remain my exclusive intellectual property. The client receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the software only after full payment has been received.

sections.heading: 5. Liability & Third Parties
sections.body: My liability is limited to the invoice value of the project. I am not liable for indirect damages, data loss, or failures caused by third-party services (e.g., AWS, Stripe, hosting providers). Updates required due to third-party "breaking changes" are considered additional work (meerwerk).

sections.heading: 6. Jurisdiction
sections.body: These terms are governed by Belgian Law. Any disputes shall be settled exclusively by the courts of the judicial district of Limburg, Hasselt division.
